Illegal Mosque Demolished in Saharanpur Following Court Order

An illegal mosque located within the Saharanpur collectorate in Uttar Pradesh was demolished after a court order was upheld. Samajwadi Party MP Iqra Hasan was reportedly placed under house arrest to prevent potential escalations. The demolition proceeded after the court confirmed its order. Akhilesh Yadav and Mayawati also reacted to the incident.
